en.headline: 429 commits across 11 repos, 47 issue actions, and 12 releases in 30 days
en.teaser: Most of the window went into OpenCode tooling: skill management, agent sandboxing, a translation extension and a pixel-logo CLI, plus bug reports filed against OpenChamber and OpenCode.
en.overview:
The 30-day window from 2026-10-05 to 2026-11-03 has no missing days. Activity totals 429 own commits, 47 issue actions, no pull requests and no reviews. A further 675 automated commits were recorded, all of them in the profile repository.

### OpenCode tooling

The largest share of work went into OpenCode-adjacent projects. `opencode-skill-management` built a `skill_management` plugin with list, inspect, disable and enable actions, shipped release candidates and then v0.2.0, v1.0.0, v1.1.0 and v1.2.0; the later versions moved all four actions to a single JSON result with a declared output schema and fixed divergent-agent counting and frontmatter boolean handling. `opencode-agent-sandbox` started from an initial commit and grew a knowledge base covering OpenCode V2 distribution, authentication, Windows path pitfalls and remote branch deletion risks. `opencode-go-model-picker` reached v1.4.0, v2.0.0, v3.0.0 and v3.0.1, adding priced accounting with per-message timestamps, a much smaller skill text, an enforced candidate menu and a comparing gate.

### Extensions and content tools

`sopen-translate` was initialized and grew an MV3 skeleton with bilingual page rendering, chunk splitting, a circuit breaker, a provider protocol layer, glossary pipeline and smoke tests, with selection translation later dropped. `pixel-logo-toolkit` shipped v0.2.0 and v0.3.0, adding automatic text wrapping, overflow protection, a bilingual CLI, a Korean font fix and a 40-image command gallery. `meld-deepresearch` released v0.3.0 and v0.4.0, turning one research skill into three cooperating skills and adding a thin `meld.py` CLI over the gates.

### Profile, blog and upstream reports

The profile repository `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` carried most of the automated commits and gained Discussions collection, a badge layout fix, a manual daily-report trigger and several rewritten flow diagrams. `asset-inventory` shipped v1.15.4 and v1.15.5 while correcting skill invocation references, and `myBlog` added OpenChamber capture screenshots. Upstream, 23 issue actions went to `openchamber/openchamber` and 12 to `anomalyco/opencode`, mostly bug reports on MCP settings, session retention, quote cards, file-view commenting and MiMo model image handling.

highlights.text: v1.0.0 froze the skill_management surface for 1.x after the v0.2.0 and release-candidate builds.
v3.0.0 cut the skill text from 104,181 to 8,291 characters, roughly 12.6 times smaller.
v0.3.0 split the research skill into meld-deepresearch, meld-da and meld-search-academic.
v0.3.0 added automatic line wrapping and proportional font-size step-down on overflow.
Opened a bug report that Settings > MCP omits the Console MCP server OpenCode adds at runtime.
Opened and later closed a report that Go endpoints reject images advertised as supported.
Started an Ideas discussion about commenting on selected code rather than line numbers.
Opened, commented on and closed a temporary opencode /oc smoke test issue.

byRepo.text: 131 own commits plus 675 automated commits, with 6 issue actions and no releases. Work covered the daily report pipeline: Discussions collection and display, a fix so a zero commit badge is no longer coerced to one, unified badge layout, forced inline code in AI summaries, a manual daily-report trigger step, and rewritten push and loop diagrams including Cloudflare Workers Builds and watchdog notes.

77 own commits, no automated commits, no issue actions, and 4 releases. Built the `skill_management` plugin with list, inspect, disable and enable, validated trusted publishing through OIDC, moved plans into `.openchamber/plans`, normalized line endings to LF, and shipped v0.2.0, v1.0.0, v1.1.0 and v1.2.0, the last two switching to a JSON result envelope and fixing divergent-agent counts and frontmatter booleans.

60 own commits, no automated commits, no issue actions and no releases. Started from an initial commit and built a knowledge base: OpenCode V2 distribution, architecture and authentication notes, Windows path pitfalls, oh-my-opencode-slim and hosted OpenCode findings, Excalidraw sketches, an AGENTS.md, corrections to stale conclusions about subcommands and bundled skills, and remote branch deletion checks.

56 own commits, no automated commits, no issue actions and no releases. Initialized the repo and built an MV3 extension: bilingual page rendering, chunk splitting, a circuit breaker, progress reporting, a provider protocol layer with presets and model lists, a glossary pipeline, JSDoc-based checkJs type checking, a DOM smoke test for two-round restore, page-state reset between runs, and removal of selection translation.

43 own commits, no automated commits, no issue actions, and 2 releases. Shipped v0.3.0 with three cooperating skills and three hard gates, then v0.4.0 with a thin `meld.py` CLI wrapping the gates and gate downgrades. Also fixed the landing page after review, clarified that the two install one-liners are alternatives, restructured the README pair, recorded the MIT notice for the adapted skill and retired test files.

25 own commits, no automated commits, no issue actions, and 4 releases. Added shared helpers for BOM-tolerant atomic JSON writes and proxy-aware reruns, expanded agent discovery with mode, hidden, traits and provenance fields, added new discovery flags, fixed version-badge drift and calibration date restamping, and shipped v1.4.0, v2.0.0, v3.0.0 and v3.0.1.

27 own commits, no automated commits, no issue actions, and 2 releases. Added automatic text wrapping and overflow protection, kept pure query commands working without Pillow, made the CLI bilingual with an English-first README, added a 40-image command gallery, switched Korean to the Galmuri font, reserved width for right-side decorations, and shipped v0.2.0 and v0.3.0.

No commits, no releases, and 23 issue actions. Filed and followed bug reports on MCP settings omitting the Console server, stale session retention hints, quote-card arrows that do nothing, unreliable line-number commenting, the project actions menu running the wrong action, context panel percentages, 1x browser captures on high-DPI displays, unlinkable agent issues, merged turns around skipped-role notices, thinking level persisting across model switches, and Go quota showing as unconfigured.

No commits, no releases, and 12 issue actions. Reported that Windows desktop ships the CLI with no way to run it, that Go endpoints reject images advertised as supported, that vision reads stale images after several in one session, and that subagents fail with model_coming_soon on MiMo-V2.6-Flash; also followed worktree removal and auth.json removal behaviour.

6 own commits, no automated commits, no issue actions and no releases. Corrected skill invocation facts across the skill, rule, samples, readmes and guides, removed stale `/asset-inventory` slash command references, fixed Japanese localization, and shipped v1.15.4 and v1.15.5.

4 own commits, no automated commits, no issue actions and no releases. Added OpenChamber capture samples at desktop, mobile and panel-region sizes plus a screenshot illustrating the session retention hint.

No commits, no releases, and 2 issue actions. Opened a bug report that reflect --sessions session discovery queries legacy V1 tables and returns zero sessions on OpenCode V2, and followed it until it was closed.

No commits, no releases, and 2 issue actions. Opened a report that OpenCode detection and the skill install path point to ~/.opencode while OpenCode uses ~/.config/opencode, and proposed a v2 integration fixing the install path and adding an mcp target.
No commits, no releases, and 1 issue action. Opened a report on OpenCode V2 compatibility covering SKILL.md frontmatter and runtime assumptions.
No commits, no releases, and 1 issue action. Opened a feature request to make the harness extensible to OpenCode and Pi and to consider exposing it as an MCP server.

zh.headline: 30 天 429 次提交、47 次 issue 互动、12 个版本发布
zh.teaser: 这段时间主要投入 OpenCode 周边工具：技能管理、Agent 沙箱、翻译扩展和像素 Logo 命令行工具，同时向 OpenChamber 与 OpenCode 提交了多份缺陷报告。
zh.overview:
2026-10-05 至 2026-11-03 的 30 天窗口没有缺失日期。总计 429 次本人提交、47 次 issue 互动，没有拉取请求，也没有代码评审。另有 675 次自动提交，全部集中在个人主页仓库。

### OpenCode 周边工具

工作量最大的是 OpenCode 相关项目。`opencode-skill-management` 实现了 `skill_management` 插件，提供 list、inspect、disable、enable 四个动作，先发布候选版本，随后发布 v0.2.0、v1.0.0、v1.1.0 和 v1.2.0；后两个版本把四个动作统一为单个 JSON 结果并声明输出 schema，同时修正了跨 Agent 差异统计和 frontmatter 布尔值处理。`opencode-agent-sandbox` 从初始提交起步，逐步积累知识库，涵盖 OpenCode V2 的分发、认证、Windows 路径坑和远程分支删除风险。`opencode-go-model-picker` 先后发布 v1.4.0、v2.0.0、v3.0.0 和 v3.0.1，加入按消息时间戳计价的核算、大幅精简的技能文本、强制的候选菜单和比对闸门。

### 扩展与内容工具

`sopen-translate` 完成初始化，并搭出 MV3 骨架：双语页面渲染、分块切分、熔断器、进度上报、Provider 协议层与预设、术语表流水线和冒烟测试，之后移除了划词翻译。`pixel-logo-toolkit` 发布 v0.2.0 和 v0.3.0，加入自动折行、溢出保护、中英双语命令行、韩文字体修正和 40 张命令示例画廊。`meld-deepresearch` 发布 v0.3.0 和 v0.4.0，把单个研究技能拆成三个协作技能，并在各闸门之上加了轻量 `meld.py` 命令行入口。

### 主页、博客与上游反馈

个人主页仓库 `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` 承载了大部分自动提交，新增 Discussions 采集与展示、徽章排版修正、日报手动触发步骤，并重画了多张流程图。`asset-inventory` 发布 v1.15.4 和 v1.15.5，同时修正技能调用说明；`myBlog` 补充了 OpenChamber 截图。上游方面，`openchamber/openchamber` 有 23 次 issue 互动，`anomalyco/opencode` 有 12 次，多为关于 MCP 设置、会话保留提示、引用卡片、文件视图评论和 MiMo 模型图片处理的缺陷报告。

highlights.text: v1.0.0 将 skill_management 的接口在 1.x 内冻结，此前已发布 v0.2.0 和候选版本。
v3.0.0 把技能文本从 104,181 字符压缩到 8,291 字符，约为原来的十二分之一。
v0.3.0 把研究技能拆分为 meld-deepresearch、meld-da 和 meld-search-academic。
v0.3.0 加入自动折行，并在溢出时按比例缩小字号。
提交缺陷报告：设置中的 MCP 页面漏掉了 OpenCode 运行时添加的 Console MCP 服务器。
提交并随后关闭报告：Go 端点拒绝接收其宣称支持的图片输入。
发起 Ideas 讨论，建议文件视图支持对选中代码而非行号发表评论。
新开、评论并关闭了一个临时的 opencode /oc 冒烟测试 issue。

byRepo.text: 131 次本人提交，另有 675 次自动提交，6 次 issue 互动，无版本发布。工作集中在日报流水线：新增 Discussions 采集与展示，修正提交角标为 0 时被兜底成 1 的问题，统一徽章排版，强制 AI 摘要内联代码，增加日报手动触发步骤，并重画推送与循环流程图，写入 Cloudflare Workers Builds 和 watchdog 相关说明。

77 次本人提交，无自动提交，无 issue 互动，发布 4 个版本。实现 `skill_management` 插件的 list、inspect、disable、enable，通过 OIDC 验证 trusted publishing，把计划迁到 `.openchamber/plans`，统一换行符为 LF，并发布 v0.2.0、v1.0.0、v1.1.0 和 v1.2.0，后两者改用 JSON 结果封装并修正差异统计与 frontmatter 布尔值。
60 次本人提交，无自动提交，无 issue 互动，无版本发布。从初始提交起步搭建知识库：记录 OpenCode V2 的分发、架构与认证，Windows 路径坑，oh-my-opencode-slim 与托管 OpenCode 的实测结论，加入 Excalidraw 草图与 AGENTS.md，修正子命令列表、随包技能数量等过期结论，并补充远程分支删除的检查与风险。
56 次本人提交，无自动提交，无 issue 互动，无版本发布。完成仓库初始化并搭出 MV3 扩展：双语页面渲染、分块切分、熔断器、进度上报、带预设与模型列表的 Provider 协议层、术语表流水线、基于 JSDoc 的 checkJs 类型检查、两轮恢复的 DOM 冒烟测试、每次翻译前重置页面状态，并移除划词翻译。
43 次本人提交，无自动提交，无 issue 互动，发布 2 个版本。v0.3.0 交付三个协作技能与三道硬闸门，v0.4.0 加入包裹各闸门的轻量 `meld.py` 命令行并放宽部分闸门。此外按评审意见修正落地页，说明两条安装命令互为替代，重构 README 双版本，记录改编技能的 MIT 声明，并把测试文件标记为退役。
25 次本人提交，无自动提交，无 issue 互动，发布 4 个版本。新增共享辅助函数，支持带 BOM 的 JSON 原子写入和按代理重跑；扩展 Agent 发现，输出 mode、hidden、traits 与 provenance 字段并新增相关参数；修正版本徽章漂移和校准日期被重盖的问题，先后发布 v1.4.0、v2.0.0、v3.0.0 和 v3.0.1。
27 次本人提交，无自动提交，无 issue 互动，发布 2 个版本。加入文本自动折行与溢出保护，保证缺少 Pillow 时纯查询命令仍可用，命令行改为中英双语并把 README 拆为英文默认加中文版，新增 40 张命令示例画廊，韩语改用 Galmuri 字体，为右侧装饰显式让出宽度，发布 v0.2.0 和 v0.3.0。
无提交，无版本发布，23 次 issue 互动。提交并跟进多份缺陷报告：MCP 设置漏掉 Console 服务器、会话保留提示过时、引用卡片箭头无反应、按行号评论不可靠、项目操作菜单执行了错误的动作、上下文面板百分比异常、高分屏下浏览器截图只有 1 倍分辨率、Agent 关联的 issue 无法解除、跳过角色提示把两条回复并成一轮、切换模型后思考等级未重置，以及 Go 配额显示为未配置。
无提交，无版本发布，12 次 issue 互动。报告 Windows 桌面版自带 CLI 却无法运行、Go 端点拒绝其宣称支持的图片、同一会话多张图片后视觉读到旧图，以及 MiMo-V2.6-Flash 上子代理报 model_coming_soon；同时跟进 worktree 删除和删除 auth.json 后的行为。
6 次本人提交，无自动提交，无 issue 互动，无版本发布。修正技能、规则、示例、README 与指南中的技能调用说明，移除过时的 `/asset-inventory` 斜杠命令引用，修复日文本地化，并发布 v1.15.4 和 v1.15.5。
4 次本人提交，无自动提交，无 issue 互动，无版本发布。新增 OpenChamber 的桌面、移动端和面板区域截图样例，以及一张说明会话保留提示的截图。
无提交，无版本发布，2 次 issue 互动。提交缺陷报告：reflect --sessions 的会话发现查询的是旧版 V1 数据表，在 OpenCode V2 上返回 0 个会话，并跟进至该 issue 被关闭。
无提交，无版本发布，2 次 issue 互动。提交报告指出 OpenCode 检测与技能安装路径指向 ~/.opencode，而 OpenCode 实际使用 ~/.config/opencode，并提出修正安装路径、增加 mcp 目标的 v2 集成建议。
无提交，无版本发布，1 次 issue 互动。提交关于 OpenCode V2 兼容性的报告，涉及 SKILL.md frontmatter 与运行时假设。
无提交，无版本发布，1 次 issue 互动。提交功能请求，希望 harness 可扩展到 OpenCode 和 Pi，并考虑以 MCP 形式对外暴露。
